samples.description: Best-effort individual analyst forecast revision events for one-year-ahead annual earnings with ACTDATS in 1990–1994. Events intersect Compustat, CRSP and I/B/E/S and require eligible prior analyst-firm forecast ability, forecast-surprise data, and complete return and price inputs. Firms must have at least five brokerage houses following them in each year 1988–1994; an analyst-firm pair must have at least five scoreable forecasts in the preceding two years with at least one in each year. The three-day revision window must not overlap another same-firm revision, earnings announcement or dividend declaration. The constructed sample has 4,223 observations; Table 4 reports 15,446.

assumptions: Supported non-USD currencies are retained; same-currency forecast differences are compared without FX, while mixed-currency amounts use documented GBP-based Xpressfeed daily/monthly cross-rates.
Compustat annual EPSPX is matched through dated SEC_IDHIST CUSIP and PRIHISTUSA primary-issue history to dated CRSP names and PERMNO.
Primary I/B/E/S estimates are paired with Compustat basic EPSPX.
The source-silent three-day market-adjusted return uses compounded CRSP RET minus compounded CRSP VWRETD.
I/B/E/S activation date ACTDATS is the event date and nontrading event dates map to the next market session.

Prior two-calendar-year ability histories require at least five scoreable forecasts with one in each year; latest-date consensus selection prefers the Detail currency, uses a unique other currency when needed, and counts ambiguous snapshots; historical Compustat actuals must have RDQ on or before the revision event.
The 80% boundary is superior and the 20% boundary is inferior; the 2nd/98th percentile return and revision cutoffs are winsorization on the final pooled sample.
Same-firm other-revision confounders include changed EPS estimates across all FPI values and both primary/diluted levels.

Detail VALUE is on its ANNDATS share basis (ACTDATS only when ANNDATS is missing), Summary MEDEST on STATPERS, and annual Compustat EPSPX on fiscal DATADATE. Per-share source factors use the last supported CRSP CFACSHR for the same PERMNO on or before each source date, bounded at five calendar days; event centers and the t-2 price anchor keep their event-calendar mapping.

I/B/E/S ANALYS identifies the contributing analyst; ESTIMATOR is used for brokerage coverage only. Nonpositive or missing analyst codes are not pooled as an identity, and cross-PERMNO revision transitions remain unknown.
The paper does not specify a consensus mean or median; the local Summary History MEDEST median is the best-effort consensus statistic.

The broad other-revision pool treats each distinct changed EPS Detail row, including another horizon, as a separate potential announcement; exact duplicates and same-time multi-horizon records are audited.

limitations: The final best-effort baseline produces 4,223 observations versus 15,446 in Table 4. Of 50,965 analyst-classified events before confounder and market-data screens, 45,946 overlap another revision, 7,307 overlap earnings announcements, 5,351 overlap dividend declarations, one lacks the full return window, and two lack the t−2 price; these counts overlap. The overlap screen is the largest measured loss, but aggregate diagnostics do not establish the cause of the paper-sample difference.

The pooled OLS slopes and pairwise tests differ materially from the published values. The full comparison, construction choices, repairs and diagnostics are documented in design.md and review.md; no sample or transformation was tuned toward published estimates.
The source does not define whether a consensus mean or median is used; Summary History MEDEST is used as a documented best-effort choice.

The source does not identify an event key for combining simultaneous revisions across forecast horizons. Distinct Detail rows are treated separately; exact duplicate rows are measured and same-time multi-horizon cardinality is reported.

The local I/B/E/S product has 218 zero ANALYS codes among 3,463,076 Detail EPS rows. Such rows are not assigned to an analyst-firm track record and remain individual unknown revisions for conservative confound screening.

The source does not report whether the analyst ability consensus is a mean or median, does not define an event key for collapsing simultaneous horizon revisions, and does not specify the availability cutoff for actual earnings. MEDEST, distinct changed Detail rows, and RDQ on or before the event are documented best-effort choices.
The source does not specify return-compounding/index details or a covariance correction. The build uses compounded CRSP value-weighted market returns and conventional pooled OLS covariance.
